scope: Calibration reduction of a real-page unnamed-banner failure. Contrast empty/named banner and empty navigation/main/complementary/contentinfo roles using same buttons and focus sequence. No independent holdout or simulator movement claim.

plan.scope: Calibration reduction of a real-page unnamed-banner failure. Contrast empty/named banner and empty navigation/main/complementary/contentinfo roles using same buttons and focus sequence. No independent holdout or simulator movement claim.
plan.inputEquivalence: Visible unique geometry, independently observed Native role/name/state/ancestors/custom content after each focus move with authored static HTML and explicit named/unnamed landmarks. AX keyboard focus is never a reading-cursor oracle. Static authored defaults have the existing verifier limits.
plan.attribution: Existing wire-request-v1 bounded-window receipt quality; completion and late receipt causality remain unproved. Min 2200ms, quiet1200ms, max8500ms. Preserve entry and description separately; prior output is not a prediction input.
plan.failurePolicy: Freeze inputs/model/predictions before either Native profile. No engine/input changes until both finish. Keep every planned action, unknown input, unexpected target, attribution failure and mismatch. Full speech includes receipt ordering and hints. No Navigation/State Accuracy/Task Success claim.
